diagnosis.price_provider: Yahoo requests inherited HTTP(S)_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9; the local port refused connections. Direct access to both Yahoo chart hosts succeeded when those exact hosts bypassed the proxy.
diagnosis.historical_analytics: Canonical clean daily closes existed, but current Company/Universe measures depended on stored legacy PriceRegimeSnapshot rows instead of deriving metrics from PriceObservation history.
diagnosis.frontend_rendering: Some live quotes carried an exchange-local market-date label one day ahead of the UTC calendar date. The query calculated age_days=-1 even though the quote was observed before the knowledge cutoff; strict frontend validation then rejected the entire market-summary response. Current-quote freshness now uses the actual recorded observation date for that ahead-of-UTC session-label case.

dependency_analysis.provider_to_canonical: The existing Yahoo adapter stores raw payloads and normalizes exact crosswalk identities into append-only PriceObservation and FxObservation rows. The startup worker calls this existing ingestion path.
dependency_analysis.portfolio_value_and_weights: Portfolio overview selects the accepted holdings snapshot at its valuation/knowledge cutoff, then selects exact-listing clean prices and dated FX independently at that cutoff. Newer market observations can mark older accepted quantities without changing holdings history.
dependency_analysis.current_model_return: Current native model calculations use the accepted revision with a quote for its exact valuation listing, bounded by as-of and known-at cutoffs. Source revision/reference-price outputs remain historical, and a quote update does not append a model revision.
dependency_analysis.ranking: Portfolio and Watchlist ranks are immutable runs that consume eligible canonical model/return state and documented context. Startup ingestion does not create or rewrite ranking runs.
dependency_analysis.execution_pace: Execution Pace separately consumes the exact-listing latest quote and the legacy PriceRegimeSnapshot label/freshness, along with current model, target and portfolio inputs. The broader legacy regime label is not inferred from price history in this milestone; stale or absent regime evidence can still yield REVIEW.
dependency_analysis.historical_views: Historical queries use canonical daily observations and honor both market effective date and recorded/observed knowledge cutoffs. Universe/Company UI reads canonical API outputs and polls market state every 30 seconds.
